MARGIN-01

Chromium page-margin boxes and page counters

Body page one

BODY-ONE-A

The title page intentionally suppresses all authored margin boxes.

BODY-ONE-B

The first body page should be numbered as physical page 2 of the four-page document.

Body page two

BODY-TWO-A

Running content should repeat without JavaScript pagination.

BODY-TWO-B

Total page count should remain four because the unnumbered title page is still part of the document.

Body page three

BODY-THREE-A

The final page should carry Page 4 of 4.

BODY-THREE-B

This fixture tests static running text and counters, not dynamic section-title running strings.
